Messages.Author: Almightyray
Messages.Body: Quick follow up, if a slave cannot take actions, what happens when they fall to 0 blood and would be forced to hunt?

Messages.Author: Xaddam
Messages.Body:
Slaves can take actions and they can block. They cannot take undirected actions without their 'master' clan ready, though.

If you mean when a gargoyle is pentex'ed and has no blood; they simply stay untapped with no blood.

Slave: Some minions are identified as slaves to a specified clan. A slave cannot take a directed action if his controller doesn't control a ready member of the specified clan. Also, if a member of the specified clan controlled by the same Methuselah is blocked, the controller can tap the slave to cancel the combat and to untap the acting vampire and have the slave enter combat with the blocking minion instead.

Adam Esbjörnsson,
Prince of Örebro

Messages.Author: finbury
Messages.Body:
Toy can play Hidden Lurker + Trap + Withering, hands, hands, Disguised Weapon an Improvised Flamethrower to reset the trap, hands, hands, hands, 2 agg. Crazy combo, but burns anyone with 6 or less blood, more if you have a WWS or Signpost handy, and it gets past both prevention and S:CE.

And then nobody will ever block you again, and your hand will fill with combat cards and Hidden Lurkers you cannot play and you will die. I didn't say it was a GOOD thing to do... it's just a thing.

It's also worth considering that there are silly numbers of G4/5 !Malks with potence or fortitde; I guess he wouldn't be bad to slip into a deck with them. Take a look:

Fabrizia Contreraz 4 dem pot G4
Apache Jones 5 DEM for obf G4
Marge Khan 7 DEM for OBF POT G5
White Lily 8 DEM for OBF, built in Disguised Weapon G4
Alicia Barrows 9 DEM OBF POT G4
Harold Zettler 9 DEM OBF POT G4

You could run Toy with the fort folks and play fortitude prevent with a scattering of Hidden Lurkers, Disarms, and Pulled Fangs; prevent + disarm works for Marge too, and anyone can prevent and pull fangs. Swallowed By The Night is a good/versatile way to get maneuvers. Or you could focus on the folks with POT and play some Torn Signposts with your Disarms.

!Malks aren't bad bruise bleeders in general, because Kindred Spirits benefits the malk player even if doesn't connect correctly. So the POT !Malk thing isn't terrible, and he's good support for it. Plus you can use The Call to get Toy for free (or at a 1 pool profit if you transfer back)

Messages.Author: Malcolm Sprye

I have a question to throw into this topic: Can you use both the Slave mechanic AND hidden lurker on the same action? i.e. a malk anti you control is blocked, so you tap Toy for the slave mechanic. After combat is over, you hidden lurker with another minion (possibly even that same malk anti!)

Does this work?

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> Malcolm wrote:
> I have a question to throw into this topic: Can you use both the Slave mechanic AND hidden lurker on the same action? i.e. a malk anti you control is blocked, so you tap Toy for the slave mechanic. After combat is over, you hidden lurker with another minion (possibly even that same malk anti!)
>
> Does this work?
>
IIRC, that doesn't work, for two reason :because the action is resolved before the combat, and because Toy never became the active minion. Don't quote me on that, thought.

Edit : if it were working, it would mean that a gargoyle that just use the slave mechanism could play Flow with the mountain to continue the action of the tremere. And it would lead to endless rules clarifications.

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
you can't queue up a combat if there's already one pending, so you can't play hidden lurker after engaging the slave rule but before the slave combat.

and as for after, you can't play it then because it requires, as ohlmann said above, a combat between the acting minion and someone to be finishing, and the slave is not acting.

--
salem
